_help.caption_signoff: The team's brand mark, put in the caption exactly as written here (assistant style rules about emojis do not apply to it). Change it here, not in the caption guide.
_help.hashtags: Added after the sign-off on every caption (pre-game and post-game), in this order.
_help.competition_hashtags: Extra hashtags for a competition (matched against game.json 'competition'), added after 'hashtags'.
_help.colors: Hex colours used by render_card.py. green_dark is the background, orange the accent, cream the main text.
_help.logo: Team logo file in this folder (square PNG, 1000 px or more).
_help.leijonat: Ids of Näädät on tulospalvelu.leijonat.fi; change only if the team moves to another series.
_help.home_arenas: Rinks where Näädät play home games. A rink counts as home when its name starts with an entry here (case-insensitive prefix: 'Kaarela' covers 'Kaarela 1' and 'Kaarela 2'). Used for hand-entered games (FCAA too) to decide home or away; the assistant asks the user when the rink matches no entry.
